latest.title: When Logs Tell the Story: Building an Effective AWS Incident Timeline
latest.description: Security incidents leave behind traces across cloud services. Learn how correlating AWS logs, identity activity, network events, and resource changes can help investigators reconstruct an incident timeline and understand the complete attack sequence.

latest.title: AWS Config Explained: Resource Configuration, Compliance and Change Tracking
latest.description:
Managing AWS resources at scale requires more than knowing when an API action occurred. Cloud engineers also need visibility into resource configurations, configuration changes, relationships, and compliance with organizational requirements.

This article explains AWS Config, configuration history, configuration items, Config Rules, conformance packs, remediation, resource relationships, compliance monitoring, and how AWS Config complements CloudTrail.

latest.title: Amazon GuardDuty: A Practical Guide to AWS Threat Detection and Automated Response
latest.description: Amazon GuardDuty continuously analyzes activity across AWS accounts and workloads to identify suspicious behavior, compromised credentials, malicious network communication, malware, abnormal API activity, and other security threats.

latest.title: My AWS Security Journey: From Curiosity to Building Resilient Systems
latest.description: From curiosity to cloud security—this is my journey of turning cybersecurity knowledge into practical, trustworthy systems with AWS. Explore how learning, building, breaking, investigating, and community leadership are shaping my next chapter in cloud security.

latest.title: How I Built an AI DevOps Assistant on AWS Using Amazon Bedrock and Claude
latest.description:
As cloud environments grow, DevOps engineers spend significant time troubleshooting logs, creating infrastructure templates, writing scripts, and searching documentation.

To simplify these repetitive tasks, I built an AI-powered DevOps Assistant using Amazon Bedrock and Claude. The assistant can help analyze errors, generate Infrastructure as Code templates, answer AWS questions, and provide troubleshooting guidance.
